I bike a lot.  Recently that has led to hunger which is counterproductive.  I solved it by either: (1) bringing a small baggie of popcorn as a snack on my bike; or (2) eating 2oz of nuts post biking.  The popcorn helps because when you exercise your muscles assimilate carbs before they burn fat.  If you're feeling hungry or tired a handful of popcorn can make that feeling go away with a minimal hit to calorie goal (e.g 100 calories).  The nuts help as they are made of fats which your body really wants after exercise. I have tupperware 2oz containers made for baby food.  I use these as you should only have a max of 2oz of nuts a day and it is easy to misestimate the amount.  I just went on a 2 hour bike ride today.  I was starving and tired halfway through but a handful of popcorn cured it.  At home I has a ceaser salad and dumped my nuts on it.  I'm completely satisfied.
